annotation.title_clean: 100 Days Mission to respond to future pandemic threats: Reducing the impact of future pandemics by making Diagnostics, Therapeutics and Vaccines available within 100 days
annotation.title_en: 100 Days Mission to respond to future pandemic threats: Reducing the impact of future pandemics by making Diagnostics, Therapeutics and Vaccines available within 100 days
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Pandemic Preparedness Partnership (report to the UK G7 Presidency)
annotation.summary_en: The file is labelled "AI for Science Strategy", but the PDF actually contains the 100 Days Mission report that the Pandemic Preparedness Partnership gave to the G7 in June 2021. The report sets out a roadmap for making diagnostics, therapeutics and vaccines available within 100 days of a pandemic threat. It does not cover AI or robotics.
key_provisions_or_claims: Aim to have safe, effective and affordable diagnostics, therapeutics and vaccines available within 100 days of WHO declaring a public health emergency of international concern (PHEIC)
Prioritise R&D on critical viral families and keep a diversity of vaccine platforms
Agree 'rules of the road' on prioritisation, speed, scale and equitable access
Invest in simpler, modular vaccine manufacturing and in new routes of administration such as oral or nasal delivery
Ensure funding is ready to draw down so the poorest countries get equitable access
